speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.

The pelvic exam and ultrasound ruled out infection, structural abnormalities, and urinary retention, and your normal kidney function makes lithium toxicity unlikely. The combination of chronic bladder pain, frequency, and pain with intercourse (dyspareunia) in the absence of other findings is characteristic of Interstitial Cystitis.
